summary: Subway Surfers entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Subway Surfers

emulation.emulator: None for primary; device screen capture preferred
emulation.notes: Use phone/tablet capture rather than an Android emulator unless input/capture testing proves the emulator mirrors the live build correctly.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Modern mobile device at native app resolution

primary.why: Subway Surfers is a live endless-runner built around the official mobile app ecosystem. The current iOS/Android build is the best practical completeness route, while web and legacy Windows Phone paths are convenience or historical alternates without sourced exclusive progression content.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current App Store or Google Play build on a modern device with clean screen capture. Record the app version and season/event state because World Tour and live events change over time.

all_releases.platform: iOS / iPadOS / Android mobile app family
all_releases.fidelity: Current official touch-control mobile route with ongoing updates and account/event support.
all_releases.reason: primary: best practical route for the live game and the platform family where the game originated and remains maintained.

all_releases.fidelity: Portable app-family route with no sourced exclusive content over iOS/Android.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful device alternate, but not the strongest capture route.

all_releases.fidelity: Official browser convenience route for keyboard play.
all_releases.reason: skip: convenient desktop capture path, but mobile remains the main live-service app route unless a browser-specific objective is being archived.
skip: historical platform support with no sourced exclusive content over current mobile builds.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: A browser route is cleaner for desktop capture, but the mobile app route is the safer completeness target for a live mobile game.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live events, seasons, and city themes change. Capture notes should record app version, date, and active event. Subway Surfers City and Subway Surfers Tag are separate games, not replacements for this entry.
